clue.text: Knight caught by battle-axe from behind, screaming?

definitions.note: loud colours are said to scream; the question mark flags the figurative sense

indicators.note: read from behind means the whole assembled piece is taken back to front
the knight is caught by the battle-axe, so his title sits inside her word

parts.note: a battle-axe is a fierce old woman, a hag
a knight is addressed as Sir

explanation.surface: A knight is seized from behind by a fearsome weapon and cries out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'battle-axe' is not the weapon but a fearsome old woman; 'from behind' reverses the whole container, HSIRAG.
explanation.definitionFit: Colours described as screaming are loud and gaudy, which is exactly a showy, tasteless look.

clue.text: Player in Rangers team ran off before misbehaving

indicators.note: the letters misbehave, rearranging after the ran letters run off

parts.note: taken as written, the letters removed from the pool

explanation.surface: A footballer in the Rangers side ran off before misbehaving.
explanation.walkthrough: Take RAN off the letters of 'Rangers team' and 'misbehaving' rearranges GERSTEAM. Rangers is a Glasgow football club.
explanation.definitionFit: A habitual gambler is a player of games of chance.

clue.text: What's left of jogger gulping air initially

indicators.note: one piece gulps the other down, taking it inside

parts.note: a memory jogger is a reminder

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of air

explanation.surface: A tired runner is all that's left after gulping air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jogger' looks like a runner but means a prompt to the memory.
explanation.definitionFit: The remainder is the part left over, a noun synonym.

clue.text: Well-built bed erected in blue

indicators.note: the bed is set inside the blue

parts.note: the sky is blue

indicators.note: erected in a down clue means put up, so read from bottom to top

parts.note: a cot is a bed

explanation.surface: A sturdy bed has been put up under a blue sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A stocky person is short and solidly built, a synonym.

clue.text: Soiled contents of wide pants revered

indicators.note: the contents of a word are its inner letters, here the middle two of wide
pants is slang for rubbish, so the letters of soiled are messed up

explanation.surface: A laundry complaint: the inside of a pair of baggy trousers is dirty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pants' looks like the trousers but is slang for rubbish, the anagram signal acting on the whole pool.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone worshipped or adored as a hero, a synonym pairing.

clue.text: Dog ending in pain ran out of woofs, in dominant barking

indicators.note: the ending and the death go inside the scrambled letters
barking is slang for mad, so the letters of dominant go crazy
the ending of a word is its last letter

parts.note: a whimsical way to say a dog has died, having no barks left

explanation.surface: A dog in pain stopped barking among dominant barking dogs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barking' (mad) scrambles the first piece into DAINMONT, and 'in' places the rest after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dandie Dinmont is a Scottish terrier breed, named after a character in Scott's novel Guy Mannering.

clue.text: Drink syrup, keeping last of confection for bird

parts.note: to lap is to drink as a cat does

indicators.note: the hairpiece keeps the letter inside it

parts.note: syrup of figs is rhyming slang for wig

indicators.note: the last of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: Drinking syrup while holding on to the last of a sweet treat.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney rhyming slang: 'syrup of figs' rhymes with wigs, so a syrup is a wig.
explanation.definitionFit: The lapwing, also called the peewit, is a crested plover, an example of a bird.

clue.text: Sauce — it has Latin starter with it

parts.note: it, meaning sex appeal, is abbreviated SA

indicators.note: the starter of a word is its first letter

parts.note: again it means sex appeal, SA

explanation.surface: A sauce with a Latin flavour served as a starter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It' as sex appeal is an old convention from the 1920s 'It girl'.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a spicy Mexican sauce of tomato, onion and chilli.

clue.text: Woman in the clutches of father, in pieces

indicators.note: the woman is clutched, held inside the father

parts.note: dad is a father
she refers to a woman

explanation.surface: A woman held tight by a father is left broken.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dashed has been smashed to pieces, like hopes dashed on rocks.

clue.text: In the Caribbean, steps taken to have chairman welcome doctor

indicators.note: the chairman is to welcome the doctor, taking him inside
this word is a container marker: it says one piece is placed inside the other, and the clue words of the pieces show which way round

parts.note: Chairman Mao, the Chinese leader
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A Caribbean chairman arranges steps so a doctor is greeted.
explanation.definitionFit: This lively dance originated in Cuba, so it is a set of Caribbean dance steps.

clue.text: An Italian city and southern US port

parts.note: Napoli is the Italian name for Naples

explanation.surface: A comparison of an Italian city with a southern American harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Annapolis, Maryland's capital on Chesapeake Bay, is a port city in the United States.

clue.text: God always had a game plan, perhaps to inspire love

indicators.note: inspire in its literal sense of breathe in, so the letter is drawn inside
perhaps signals that the letters could be arranged another way

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, so O

explanation.surface: God has always had a master plan, perhaps to inspire love.
explanation.definitionFit: In Revelation God is the first and the last, the beginning and end, eternal.

clue.text: Hang for robbery

definitions.meaning: to put a notice up on a wall, to display or pin up

explanation.surface: Execution as punishment for theft.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb phrase it means to pin up or display; as a noun it is an armed hold-up.

clue.text: Ape — I breed without it

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the breeding word goes round it

parts.note: animals breed when they mate

explanation.surface: An ape protests that it reproduces without some thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but means 'outside': MATE surrounds IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To ape someone is to copy or mimic them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Current toy needing no introduction

indicators.note: the toy word loses its opening letter, its introduction

parts.note: a teddy bear is a child's toy

explanation.surface: A popular toy so famous it needs no introduction.
explanation.definitionFit: A whirl of water or air against the main flow is a small circular current.

clue.text: Group, elderly, given hospital treatment

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians
aged means old

explanation.surface: A party of old people receives care in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dressed with strips of gauze over a wound is a form of hospital treatment.

clue.text: Unqualified, losing claim

parts.note: a team that is down is losing
a right is a claim or entitlement

explanation.surface: A disqualified claimant losing their case.
explanation.definitionFit: An unqualified success is a complete or utter one, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Quick survey when finished?

parts.note: once means when, as in once done
over means finished

explanation.surface: A quick inspection carried out when all is done.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapid inspection or brief look at something is a quick survey.

clue.text: Deep notes ran amok

indicators.note: running amok is going wild, so these letters scatter into a new order

explanation.surface: Low musical notes went out of control.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep, booming sound is one that rings and reverberates, a near synonym.

clue.text: Greek dish is suitable to serve up before a party

indicators.note: one piece comes before another
served up in a down clue means turned upwards, read bottom to top

parts.note: fits means is suitable
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A Greek dish fit to serve before a celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to serve up' turns FITS into STIF.
explanation.definitionFit: Stifado is a Greek stew of beef with onions, a national dish.

clue.text: Bird took to the water, tail a little further back?

indicators.note: the final letter is moved one place further along the alphabet

parts.note: swam means took to the water

explanation.surface: A bird entered the water, its tail sitting slightly further back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tail a little further back' changes the last letter M to N, the next letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: The swan is a large, long-necked water bird, an example of the category.

clue.text: Chain of bones over middle of vital organ

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the second

parts.note: the spine is a chain of vertebrae

indicators.note: the middle letter of vital

explanation.surface: An anatomical description: a chain of bones above the centre of a vital organ.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ' is the musical instrument, not a body part.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinet is a small keyboard instrument, a kind of harpsichord or small organ.

clue.text: Betting chance zero, still

parts.note: evens is an even-money chance in betting
zero looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: The odds of winning are still nil.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean nevertheless or yet, introducing a contrasting point.

clue.text: Building extension, incomplete image on the left side

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: the image word is left unfinished, losing its final letter

parts.note: an icon is an image

explanation.surface: A building extension whose picture is unfinished on its left side.
explanation.definitionFit: A porch of columns built out in front of a building's entrance is an extension of it.

clue.text: One in eight, perhaps, one in dispute?

definitions.meaning: an oarsman in an eight, a racing boat crew
someone having a row, a quarrel

explanation.surface: A crew member who is also in a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A crew member pulls an oar in an eight; whimsically, someone who rows (rhymes with cows) quarrels.

clue.text: Poetry by leaders in benefits office turned heads

indicators.note: one piece placed by another, side by side
the two leading letters are turned round
leaders are the first letters of the following words

parts.note: verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Poetry about a benefits office where heads turned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders in benefits office' gives BO, which 'turned' makes OB.
explanation.definitionFit: The face of a coin bearing the monarch's portrait is its obverse, the heads side.

clue.text: Retailer offering fresh herb with nuts, oddly

parts.note: fresh means new
sage is a herb

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters, first and third, are taken from nuts

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper selling fresh herbs and nuts with odd behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: A shopkeeper selling papers and magazines is a kind of retailer.

clue.text: Somewhat unresponsive, gentleman recovered in desert

indicators.note: read as re-covered, covered going back over the ground the other way
only some of the letters of the two words are used, a run across them

explanation.surface: A somewhat unresponsive gentleman recovered in the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somewhat' takes VEGEN from 'unresponsive, gentleman'; 'recovered' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: The Negev is the arid desert region covering southern Israel.

clue.text: Jet engine, but no RAF manoeuvres

indicators.note: the letters perform manoeuvres, moving about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An aircraft engine, though the air force isn't flying any manoeuvres.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a type of jet engine with a large front fan, used on airliners.

clue.text: Advert shows model holding rear of product

indicators.note: the model word holds the next letter inside it

parts.note: a model poses, so is a poser

indicators.note: the rear of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A marketing advert has a model clutching the back of a product.
explanation.definitionFit: A printed bill stuck on a wall to promote something is an advertisement.
